theorems.name: Submission.cmcdt_lpoh_interp_calculus
theorems.statement: ∀ (N N' : ℕ) (f g : Euclid N → Euclid N'), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) f → ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → ∃ h : Euclid (N + 1) → Euclid N', ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) h ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) = f x + t • (g x - f x)) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (EuclideanSpace.single 0 1) = g x - f x) ∧ (∀ (t : ℝ) (x v : Euclid N), fderiv ℝ h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x))) (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons 0 (WithLp.ofLp v))) = fderiv ℝ f x v + t • (fderiv ℝ g x v - fderiv ℝ f x v)) ∧ ∀ (t : ℝ) (x : Euclid N), ‖fderiv ℝ h (WithLp.toLp 2 (Fin.cons t (WithLp.ofLp x)))‖ ≤ ‖g x - f x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖ + |t| * (‖fderiv ℝ g x‖ + ‖fderiv ℝ f x‖)
